tutorial.page_1:
[u][b]Chapter 1[/b][/u]

[b]The Goal[/b]

The goal of the game is to win two rounds by reaching 21 with numeric cards or get as close as possible.
tutorial.page_2:
[u][b]Chapter 2[/b][/u]

[b]The Turn[/b]

On your turn, you can draw a numeric card or draw/play a Power Card, which grants you abilities during matches.
tutorial.page_3:
[u][b]Chapter 3[/b][/u]

[b]The Relics[/b]

After finishing a match, you choose a relic that will passively help you for the rest of the game.
tutorial.page_4:
[u][b]Chapter 4[/b][/u]

[b]The Loser[/b]

You lose the round if the total value of your cards exceeds 21, or if your opponent obtains a higher sum than yours.
tutorial.page_5:
[u][b]Chapter 5[/b][/u]

[b]The Tie[/b]

When there's a tie or both players exceed 21, no point is awarded, and a new round starts.
